title: ReKep: Spatio-Temporal Reasoning of Relational Keypoint Constraints for Robotic Manipulation
summary: A manipulation framework that expresses tasks as optimizable relational keypoint constraints across temporal stages.

mechanisms.name: Relational keypoint constraints
mechanisms.description: Turns semantic keypoints and their spatial-temporal relations into explicit cost functions that can be checked and optimized stage by stage.
mechanisms.limitations: Optimization assumes meaningful keypoints and robot control; it cannot recover missing source information or certify human-safe completion.
